content.title: Currencies in Competition:The Emergence of International Money in a Multipolar World
content.abstract: The research question this dissertation seeks to address is: 1. What causes a currency to emerge and sustain itself as world money? The sub-questions are: 2a. What is the relationship between theories of world money and theories of money? 2b. What is the appropriate indicator of world money status? The prescriptive and policy relevance of these questions are paramount. Should a country seeking to expand the international use of its currency focus on the transactional uses of its money in trade, foreign exchange and commodity markets?
